weaknesses: Abstract lacks clarity on the specific contributions of the ToolE dataset compared to existing datasets.
The paper does not sufficiently address the limitations of the proposed benchmark in real-world applications.
The experimental results do not provide a comprehensive comparison with existing benchmarks, limiting the context for the findings.
strengths: The introduction of the MetaTool benchmark fills a significant gap in evaluating LLMs' tool usage capabilities.
The detailed error analysis provides valuable insights into the challenges faced by LLMs in tool selection.
The comprehensive dataset generation process for ToolE demonstrates a rigorous approach to addressing overlapping tool functionalities.
